description: Token prices used to ESTIMATE AI cost in the portfolio backtest. Anthropic list prices per million tokens, which also apply to Claude on Microsoft Foundry (billed through the Microsoft Marketplace at standard API rates). Source: Anthropic model pricing table, as cached on 2026-10-06. Verify against your Azure invoice and edit here, or override with the AI_PRICING_JSON environment variable (same shape as 'models').
